meta_description: Matheson's Towing & Recovery, LLC serving Lenoir - towing that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: Towing in Lenoir that shows up when you call.
hero_lede: Towing service in Lenoir. Recent jobs are on the photos page.
cta_h2: Call us and we will come to you
quote_h2: Tell us what is going on with the vehicle
footer_blurb: Matheson's Towing & Recovery, LLC serving Lenoir.
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers powersports and small equipment, winch-out and recovery, car and light truck transport. We work out of Lenoir and the towns around it.
svc_hero_h1: The towing work we take on

services.title: Powersports and small equipment
services.body: Golf carts and yard machines are winched up and strapped down the same way a car is, so they arrive the way they left.
services.alt: Black tow truck hauling a teal classic car parked near a red-roofed building
services.evidence: Black tow truck hauling a small off-road UTV through the snow

services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.
services.alt: White Ram pickup pulling a trailer loaded with a small storage shed near a wooded lot
services.evidence: Five staff members in matching company shirts standing in front of a tow truck in a grassy

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.alt: Black tow truck hauling a blue classic muscle car near a metal building
services.evidence: Five staff members in matching company shirts standing in front of a tow truck in a grassy

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads
services.body: Anything that will sit on a deck can move on one, from plant and trailers to whole buildings.
services.evidence: Black tow truck hauling a large stack of logs near a brick building

services.title: Night and out of hours calls
services.body: Breakdowns do not keep office hours, and a good part of this work happens in the dark.

reviews.author: Althea Watson
reviews.text: Matheson’s Hauling is the only towing company we will ever use. We have used them multiple times over the past 20 plus years. They offer quick and reasonably priced services! They will drop what they are doing to come help you day or night. Even on Holidays or bad weather they are always available to help you! Thank you for the many times you have helped us out! We appreciate you!

reviews.author: Dillan Wright
reviews.text: Used several times and have had nothing but a great experience. These folks are priced great, always cool, and generally great to deal with. They have my business for good!

reviews.author: Leah Horton
reviews.text: When my daughter had her wreck, Matheson Towing did everything they could to assist and help. Her paycheck had fallen into the floorboard and the absorbent mess had been shoveled on top. The staff at Matheson went out into the rain, dug through the mess, found her paycheck, and laid it in front of a heater to dry. Matheson Towing also assisted my mother in law when she locked her keys in her car. Within 25 mins of calling, Matheson showed up and unlocked her car. They charged a very reasonable price.

reviews.author: Dolly Rice-Doolittle
reviews.text: Had our car picked up on the weekend after hours, Monro and his wife were at my vehicle within ten minutes of calling them. Loaded my vehicle, dropped it off at the repair shop of my choice and drove me home. They are very friendly and professional. A+ on the price of the service. These are the people to call if you need a tow. Will be calling them again if needed.

reviews.author: Torie Rene
reviews.text: I would give them 10 stars if I could! Professional, extremely fast and efficient, and very affordable! I came out of Walmart and my truck would not start. I called Matheson’s. I told them where I was broken down and exactly where I needed it to go and they gave me a quote instantly on the phone and I told him to send the driver on over. Within 10 minutes of this call, there was a tow truck driver pulling in and loading me up. The whole process between calling to dropping me off at my mechanics was less than 45 mins. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Charles Hydrick
reviews.text: I called the boss to get a price, well he said he was the owner. Told me to text him the information where the car was and where it was to be towed to get a price. And showed up with my car with $120 tow bill. Who even does that? If I didn't have the money they would have took it to their tow yard and charged me every day until I could have paid. Very embarrassing for a local tow company. I guess never text the information unless you're able to pay whatever price they give you.

reviews.author: Barbara Harmon
reviews.text: Great family and business! They have done numerous things for me and my family and I have nothing bad to say about this business at all!!

reviews.author: Gage Begley
reviews.text: 110% RECOMMEND!! My wife called and they were here within 10MINUTES to unlock her car THAT WAS RUNNING!!!! These guys are the REAL DEAL and PROFESSIONAL!! They have a customer for LIFE with us!!! Thank you so much guys for everything!! We appreciate you so much!!!

reviews.author: KnM Hansen
reviews.text: If you ever need a tow service these are the best company to call hands down !!! Such amazing people!! Thank you!!!!! I’ve used them twice and they will be my go to from here on !!!!!!!

reviews.author: Stephenie Bunzel
reviews.text: Arrived quickly and were super helpful in getting our moving truck unstuck. Very reasonable priced. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Amanda Emke
reviews.text: Second time I have used them for locking my keys in my vehicle. This time in the pouring rain. They were fast, efficient, excellent customer service and more than fair pricing. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Laura Cassell
reviews.text: These guys are a lifesaver. We had an accident of trying to drive over something we could not get out from. Matheson’s was there within five minutes of the call and pulled the car safely. You can put your trust in this company.

reviews.author: Stephanie Hensley
reviews.text: Called Matheson’s and had them tow my van from hickory because it refused to crank. They were there quickly! I had my seven year old with me and he was terrified. When the driver had my van on the truck, he made sure to check on my son and explain that everything was going to be ok. Amazing service, amazing people!

reviews.author: Anonymous Anonymous
reviews.text: Watched one of their drivers, or the owner, destroy part of the wood barrier at the Brown Mountain Overlook pull out on 181 in Burke County. It was about somewhere around 10-11 pm, 10/12/2024. It was pretty clear the driver, nor the company, are going to try and make it right. The driver left the overlook like a bat out of hell. If one of your trucks has some damage to the right front bumper, this is why. Just another towing company with zero integrity. Edit: Went back, tearing out the damaged wood fencing is their supposed way of "making it right."

reviews.author: Melanie Annas
reviews.text: The prices are very reasonable and very quick to arrive at stranded location!!! The driver took his time to make sure to safely load the jeep ( lower ball joint went out) without causing damge!! Awesome job!! I highly recommend

reviews.author: Matthew Chandler
reviews.text: Had to have my work van towed in a hurry, and these guys were on it in no time! Very easy to work with and had great rates. 5 star! Will never use a different towing service again. Thank you guys!

reviews.author: Dana Snyder
reviews.text: Matheson Towing has helped out our small car lot. We appreciate their prompt service and communication skills. Mark and his crew are always available-at any time. They also helped tow a few personal vehicles after an accident. Professional service that we recommend.

reviews.author: Lyndsie Link
reviews.text: Long story short they were quick to answer and assist. Could not be more thankful for this company tonight. Fast, courteous and affordable. Would absolutely recommend.

reviews.author: Angela Poarch
reviews.text: Was asked to rext address, I did and never got a response. Called tuckers and got estimate immediately. They came right way too. Still waiting on Matheson to respond.

reviews.author: Brandon Collins
reviews.text: Great company, we opened a towing company also, does anyone know who they have insurance with? I have to have insurance before operation and I got a few from other towing companies I'm trying to compare which is the best to get. If anyone knows who they use that would be great to know.

reviews.author: Regina Messer
reviews.text: Mark is the greatest. Didn't have a wait long before my 4runner was delivered to my house. Mark also recommend a place to find a transmission fast. Thanks Mark!!

reviews.author: Brooke Wilcox
reviews.text: I called them the other day to get a tow and whoever the operator is she is very disrespectful and rude.. I called just to get a tow because I accidentally backed my vehicle into a ditch and it got stuck because I was trying not to hit my friends car. (Which was in the way). She asked me if it was a wreck and I didn’t know what to say so I said kinda sorta and she said “Well you need to call the law enforcement first before you call us.” *with a snooty attitude* Not everybody wants to get the law involved when they ACCIDENTALLY back into a ditch! Also, when you need to pay them they wait till late at night to call you. Not everybody stays up late.

reviews.author: L. Lively
reviews.text: Matheson Towing came within 15 mins on Thanksgiving Day, dropped me off at my home then dropped the car at Fowlers Auto. Very pleased with this towing service. Thank you!

reviews.author: Chris Smith
reviews.text: Fast, friendly, affordable. The only time Ive ever had to call a tow service but I can't imagine another tow service being any better. Thank You!

reviews.author: Neith Brock
reviews.text: Had picked a car up from an auction had to get towed to local tire place. They were very quick and price was decent. Cost me 45$ good people

reviews.author: Melinda Griffin
reviews.text: Fast, reliable, reasonable and professional service. We’ve used Matheson’s numerous times and they consistently deliver an excellent customer experience.

reviews.author: Auto Supplies
reviews.text: 5'stars good quick affordable service , friendly people. Maybe a little to sweet if you know what I'm saying. Overall good experience

reviews.author: Robert Angley
reviews.text: Fast getting there. Efficient completing the work with excellent prices. And most importantly, caring and kind!

reviews.author: Nathan Coffey
reviews.text: Excellent service. Mark and his guys are great! Thanks again for helping me Mark. Appreciate your service.

reviews.author: Erica Lafferty
reviews.text: My car was stolen and impounded but bc the lot I got it from as it turns out never had my title to send it off as they were supposed to do and mathesons won't accept my bill of sale from purchase as ownership I now have no vehicle and he refuses to even let me have access to my belongings in my car!

reviews.author: Linda “LindaSue” Dancy
reviews.text: Matheson's is my choice for car towing services. They are friendly and always professional and prompt. I highly recommend them for anyone in need of assistance. Thank you Mathesons.

reviews.author: Sharon Mitcham
reviews.text: Very friendly, efficient, affordable and dependable. Very quick to response. I'd recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Gage McGuire
reviews.text: I have had 2 vehicles hauled by Matheson, they have been very fast and efficient. Each time it costed me $45, which was way less then I expected.

reviews.author: Jason Braswell
reviews.text: I locked my keys in my car and they had it unlocked within an hour. Great service and quick response, would recommend

reviews.author: Joy Guion
reviews.text: Didn't waste no time getting to my car and took good care of my car. Honest and fair people. Best in the county.

reviews.author: Amy Brass
reviews.text: Fast, Friendly service. Highly recommend! Turned a stressful situation into a better situation. Thank you for your help!

reviews.author: Kylie Storie
reviews.text: The ONLY company in the area I’ll call to have my vehicles towed! Spectacular service and speedy response!

reviews.author: Michael G
reviews.text: This is by far the best towing company over ever used. They are fast honest and very fair priced. My car tore up on the side of the road and they took it across town to a shop and only charged 65 bucks. I just moved to Lenoir and where I use to live places charged more than that to come jump start your car I honestly haven’t had a tow cost that cheap in over 10 years. The following the day the shop called and informed me it was to complex of job for them and the only place I could find to get it in quick that could do the repair was the dodge dealership in Boone so I called them back to pick the car back up and take it to Boone and the bill was only 165. To me that is more than fair pricing. Both times he told me it may be a little bit before he could get there but both times he showed up in very timely fashion. Both times the guy was very friendly and don’t a great job taking care of the vehicle while loading. I would highly recommend them to everyone and I wouldn’t use anyone else in the area

reviews.author: tiffiniSM beauty
reviews.text: I have had to use Matheson Towing quite a bit over the years. I am grateful we have them in our community. Anytime I have needed them, they have been there. They are fast, friendly, and very reasonably priced. They are also very good people. I highly recommend them for all of your towing needs, they are top tier!!!

reviews.author: Dawn Ollis
reviews.text: Great company to do business with. They were super nice an respectful. Will definitely be using them for any of my needs

reviews.author: Alicia Elder
reviews.text: Matheson's has provided timely reliable service every time I've needed them. There is no one else I would call or trust with my vehicles. They have excellent customer service and great pricing. If you ever find yourself in need of a tow definitely give Matheson's a call, you won't regret it!

reviews.author: warren hartman
reviews.text: Was a company that was just doing its job. The lady in the office was super polite and was true to her word. Out of bad things you meet some very civilized people. Thank you for your help and honesty. I will use them if I ever need a tow. A+++
